vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bundle into a single PR and bypass prConcurrentLimit (Renovate exempts vulnerability alerts from PR/branch limits).

packageRules.description: One PR for every non-major update across all managers. Placed after the groups above so they only apply to majors, which still get their own PRs.

Must stay last: the Rust crate and the npm package must bump together or `tauri build` aborts on a major/minor mismatch. Later rules win, so this reclaims the tauri packages from the non-major group above.
